##worked examples
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_sites)
colnames(breeding_sites)
glimpse(breeding_sites)
print(nrow(breeding_sites))
print(ncol(breeding_sites))
print(dim(breeding_sites))

bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_sites |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude)
gt(bird_breeding_selected)

bird_breeding_selected2 <- breeding_sites |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct()
gt(bird_breeding_selected2)
```

```{r}
my_numbers <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)

sum(my_numbers)

my_numbers <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
my_numbers |> sum()

print(my_numbers |> sum() |> sqrt() |> round())
```

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_sites)


bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_sites |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct() |> rename(Position = Site, Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)
gt(bird_breeding_selected)

bird_breeding_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Position == "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_dartmoor)

bird_breeding_not_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Position != "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_not_dartmoor)

bird_breeding_exc <- breeding_sites |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
MCD <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(MCD)
Migration_Site_exc <- MCD |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(Migration_Site_exc)
```


```{r}
##birdmigrationsites wow!
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
MCD <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(MCD)
bird_migration_selected <- MCD |> select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |> distinct() |> rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Lonitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Lonitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat) 
gt(bird_migration_selected)
```








## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this 

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
